entities.summary: Landry Addison Fields is an American professional basketball executive and former player. He is the former general manager of the Atlanta Hawks of the National Basketball Association (NBA). Fields played five seasons in the NBA for the New York Knicks and Toronto Raptors from 2010 through 2015.
